background: Shanell Stanley is the Fremont County commissioner-elect for District 3 and takes office in January 2027, succeeding Ron Fabrizius, who is serving through the current term. A County 10 campaign announcement in June 2026 described her as a lifetime Fremont County resident whose professional career was spent working with students and families in Fremont County schools, and reported that she said she had retired and was seeking another way to serve the community. She defeated Fabrizius and Ryan W. Preston in the August 18, 2026, Republican primary and was unopposed in the November general election.
